# ZUI Components

> ZUI is the production Svelte 5 component system used by ZAdmin. This site runs the real workspace components and publishes their typed metadata, keyboard contracts, accessibility notes, demos, and exact demo source.

## Documentation

- [Component catalog](./#/): Browse every implemented public component by category.
- [Getting Started](./#/guides/getting-started): Install peers, configure ZProvider, and choose controlled or uncontrolled ownership.
- [ICSS](./#/guides/icss): Configure preprocessing, typed declarations, semantic tokens, dynamic values, and strict CSP mode.
- [Theme Lab](./#/guides/theme): Inspect theme tokens, color schemes, density, contrast, direction, and reduced-motion behavior.
- [Accessibility](./#/guides/accessibility): Review native semantics, keyboard collections, focus, overlays, contrast, and motion contracts.
- [SSR and CSP](./#/guides/ssr-csp): Install request-local style registries, critical CSS, nonce or hash policies, and hydration boundaries.
- [HMR](./#/guides/hmr): Preserve state while replacing recipe ownership and cleaning runtime resources.
- [WebView](./#/guides/webview): Keep Svelte UI separate from desktop host capabilities and validate WebView2 boundaries.
- [Package](./#/guides/package): Consume public entrypoints and understand API snapshots, publish dry-runs, and external tarball acceptance.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/kenconnet666/zadmin/tree/master/ui/zui): Read the component library source and package configuration.

## Usage

- Package: `@zadmin/zui`
- Framework: Svelte 5 with TypeScript
- Styling: ZUI-owned ICSS runtime, typed Theme tokens, and recipe variants
- Accessibility: Native HTML first, explicit ARIA only where required, and real-browser Axe/Lighthouse coverage

Prefer each component page's generated API tables and accessibility section over inferred behavior. Internal planning files under `.docs` are engineering records and are not part of the public component API.
